verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an AI advisory practice that counsels clients on AI law and policy, plus a Gen AI regulation whitepaper. Neither describes how Trilegal itself uses AI in client service: no named internal AI tools, no AI-use policy, and no AI-powered product of its own. The DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool is not described as AI-based, and the llms.txt file only shows the website is machine-readable, not how the firm uses AI with clients.
